data.narrative:
Phaidra is a Series B-stage AI & Software company founded by Jim Gao (ex-Google DeepMind, led industrial AI including data center cooling work), Vedavyas Panneershelvam (AlphaGo engineer at DeepMind), and Katherine Hoffman (operations, ex-Trane Technologies and Raytheon). The company has raised $120M to date. Valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public (Palantir), all in AI & Software at similar or analogous stages.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $120M raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implying a $228M valuation. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same-stage companies—Scale AI ($29.0B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B)—yields a median valuation of $4.4B, with range $2.0B to $29.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous deal sizes and market positioning within the AI sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $194M (low) to $5.1B (high), with a median of $2.3B. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively on capital deployed; peer-median drives the upper bound but reflects significant dispersion. Key uncertainties include revenue, unit economics, and competitive positioning within industrial AI and software infrastructure—data not available for this analysis.
